segments.headline: Humanoid maker Agility lists on Nasdaq

beats.narration: Agility Robotics, maker of the Digit humanoid, just listed on the Nasdaq. What did it earn last year?
Agility calls itself the first publicly listed U.S. company focused only on humanoids.
It says it has more than three hundred million dollars in Digit 5 orders, subject to milestones.

visual.sub: Company claim · subject to contractual milestones

beats.narration: The answer, per The Robot Report: one point seven eight million dollars in revenue in twenty twenty-five.
And a net loss of one hundred thirty-eight point one million. Not from Agility's own release.
And Digit 5's general availability is targeted for the end of twenty twenty-seven.
What those orders depend on is in this week's full episode. Tap the link below.
